Conceptualization: Who originated the idea and decided what question the work would address?
I am after the person who defined the question at the outset. Later work on methodology would not by itself count.
Data curation: Point me to the contributor who checked, annotated and assembled the raw records into the released dataset.
I need someone with hands-on data curation experience, from cleaning records to maintaining the final dataset.
Formal analysis: Identify a coauthor who estimated the effects and interpreted the numerical results.
Which contributor ran the inferential procedures themselves? Data curation on its own does not meet this requirement.
Investigation: Who was actively involved in collecting the primary observations or carrying out the study procedures?
I need someone who actually conducted the investigation, even if the experimental design was someone else's.
Methodology: Find a contributor who devised the methods used to answer the research question.
Who chose and developed the research protocol? Doing the investigation after the protocol was set would not qualify.
Software: I want a contributor who implemented the tools in code, regardless of who presented the results.
Find a software contributor who wrote or maintained the programs used in the study.
Validation: Can you find someone who independently checked that the study results were reliable or could be reproduced?
Which coauthor verified the outputs? Formal analysis alone does not show they performed those checks.
Visualization: Point me to an author who designed and produced the figures used to communicate the results.
I specifically need a contributor who did the visualization and prepared the graphical presentation.
